verdict.rationale: The documentation shows natural language at the core of the experience. Users can chat with and ask questions of their sources, steer behavior with free-text custom instructions ("Respond like a PhD student"), create custom report types, and use Deep Research to gather web sources into a notebook. However, the documented ways of operating the product, such as converting notes to sources, saving to notes, choosing Audio Overview formats and selecting sources, are UI selections rather than natural-language commands. Missing for 10: evidence that product actions (generating overviews/slides, managing sources and notes) can be triggered by natural-language commands, and independent hands-on corroboration of command-style operation.
